title: Ditch monthly AI bills — compare answers from ChatGPT, Claude, and more for $30
excerpt: Find the best AI answer without opening a dozen tabs.
content_html:
TL;DR: Stop all your AI subscriptions with this lifetime subscription to AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan for $29.97 (reg. $499), code SAVE10, until Nov. 1.

When you’re making an important decision, you probably don’t just ask for one person’s opinion. So why do you settle for one answer when you’re working with AI? Give yourself extra peace of mind with help from AskAnyModel AI. This helpful tool lets you compare answers from more than 50 AI models, all in one convenient window.

Right now, you can score a lifetime subscription to AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan for just $29.97 with code SAVE10 until Nov. 1.

AI is great for saving you time, but it kind of defeats the purpose when you have to tab-hop to get a second opinion. AskAnyModel AI Pro serves up answers from dozens of models in one spot, so you can stop second-guessing and rest easy knowing you picked the best results for your query.

Gone are the days of memorizing each individual AI model’s unique strengths — AskAnyModel AI streamlines your workflow by showing you answers from six AI models of your choice in one spot. Compare them and pick the best response for your request — whether it be help with coding, generating images, or just answering a basic question.

With the AskAnyModel AI Pro Plan, you have unlimited access to non-flagship AI models. You’ll also have 500 premium monthly credits that grant you access to 20 advanced models, like OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, and Perplexity, when you need a more powerful model for your query. You can also swap between different models mid-conversation if needed.

You can use AskAnyModel AI on any device; you just need access to a web browser.
